name: Sunset
summary: Half orange-red sun sinking at a horizon with glow bands and reflections, for evening scenes. Anim: set.

params.name: y
params.note: y of the horizon line; the sun sits above it

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 about 1040 px wide, glow bands reach about 680 px above y

params.name: anim
params.note: set = the sun sinks slowly over 5 seconds
